class SparseTable {
public:
    vector<vector<ll>> st;
    vi log;
    SparseTable(vll& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        st.assign(n, vll(25, 0));
        log.resize(n+2);
        build_log(n+1);
        build(arr);
    }
    void build(vll& arr) {
        int n = arr.size();
        for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 25; j++) {
                int r = i + (1 << j) - 1;
                if (r >= n) break;
                if (j == 0) st[i][j] = arr[i];
                else st[i][j] = min(st[i][j-1], st[i + (1 << (j-1))][j-1]);
            }
        }
    }
    ll query(int l, int r) {
        int w = r - l + 1;
        int power = log[w];
        return min(st[l][power], st[r - (1 << power) + 1][power]);
    }
    void build_log(int n) {
        log[1] = 0;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            log[i] = 1 + log[i/2];
        }
    }
};
